cards.notes: CORRECTION: the '10% brand rate' is real but conditional and capped. Official T&C (jupiter.money/edge-csb-terms-conditions, versions to 9-Oct-2026 and from 10-Oct-2026): shopping brands (Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Tata Cliq, Ajio, Nykaa, Croma, Reliance Digital, Trent/Tata Retail, Reliance Retail) earn 50% Jewels (=50 Jewels per Rs100) only when total qualifying spend in the statement cycle exceeds Rs15,000 (from 10-Oct-2026; before that unconditional), else 5% Jewels; Jupiter Flights 25%; everything else 5% Jewels; 'Others (Restricted)' MCCs earn nothing. 'X% Jewels' = X Jewels per Rs100 (Jupiter's own savings table: 5% UPI Jewels on Rs1.44L = Rs1,440 => 1 Jewel = Rs0.20). Redemption value per Jewel: Rs0.20 (Jupiter Flights, Store, brand vouchers, digital gold) or Rs0.14 (statement credit, bill payments, cash). Jewel earning excludes: fuel, government, rent, utilities, wallet/gift/prepaid card loads/vouchers, cash advances, card bill payment, EMI, telecom (4814), cable (4899), insurance (6381/6300), tax, tolls, gaming, quasi-cash and others; MCCs 5944/5094 (jewellery) are not in the list but the terms do not say jewellery explicitly. rules.desc: 50 Jewels per Rs100 (billed '50% Jewels') ONLY if the statement cycle's qualifying spend exceeds Rs15,000; otherwise 5 Jewels/Rs100 (0.7% cash/1% best). Jewel = Rs0.14 on statement credit/cash/bill pay, Rs0.20 on Jupiter flights/store/vouchers/gold => 7% / 10%. Caps (T&C, from 10-Oct-2026): 10,000 Jewels per cycle for the category (Rs1,400 cash / Rs2,000 best), 3,000 Jewels per merchant (Rs420 / Rs600), 1,000 Jewels per transaction (so max_txn_inr 2000 is the spend that earns full 50 Jewels). 5 Jewels/Rs100 credited instantly, remaining 45 at cycle end. Gift cards (MCC 5947), utilities (4900), subscriptions, insurance (6300) do not count as Shopping.
25 Jewels per Rs100 on Jupiter Flights; cap 5,000 Jewels per cycle (Rs700 cash at Rs0.14 / Rs1,000 at Rs0.20).

cards.notes: CORRECTION: the '10% brand rate' is real but conditional and capped. Official T&C (jupiter.money/edge-csb-terms-conditions, versions to 9-Oct-2026 and from 10-Oct-2026): shopping brands (Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Tata Cliq, Ajio, Nykaa, Croma, Reliance Digital, Trent/Tata Retail, Reliance Retail) earn 50% Jewels (=50 Jewels per Rs100) only when total qualifying spend in the statement cycle exceeds Rs15,000 (from 10-Oct-2026; before that unconditional), else 5% Jewels; Jupiter Flights 25%; everything else 5% Jewels; 'Others (Restricted)' MCCs earn nothing. 'X% Jewels' = X Jewels per Rs100 (Jupiter's own savings table: 5% UPI Jewels on Rs1.44L = Rs1,440 => 1 Jewel = Rs0.20). Redemption value per Jewel: Rs0.20 (Jupiter Flights, Store, brand vouchers, digital gold) or Rs0.14 (statement credit, bill payments, cash). Jewel earning excludes: fuel, government, rent, utilities, wallet/gift/prepaid card loads/vouchers, cash advances, card bill payment, EMI, telecom (4814), cable (4899), insurance (6381/6300), tax, tolls, gaming, quasi-cash and others; MCCs 5944/5094 (jewellery) are not in the list but the terms do not say jewellery explicitly. T&C clause 3a says Edge+ Jewels apply 'only for transactions on the Jupiter UPI app' (UPI intent/scan & pay/collect), which conflicts with the card-brand table and 'all online & offline spends' marketing: whether card-swipe/online transactions earn 50%/25%/5% outside the Jupiter UPI app is UNCONFIRMED. KFS (5-Nov-2025, effective 6-Dec-2025): Edge+ joining Rs999 (Jupiter page shows Rs0 limited-period offer; CSB page says Rs499 for first 2 lakh users), annual nil, forex 3.5%, 1% fuel surcharge waiver on Rs400-3,000 (max Rs100), fuel fee 1% above Rs10,000 txn/Rs50,000 monthly, rent 1% (min Rs149), wallet 1%, education 1%, utility 1% on >Rs20,000, late fee 5% min Rs250 max Rs2,000. Credit limit up to Rs7 lakh.
